note: useFileSettings: true. The settings block turns the optimiser off (postroute off), keeps vias on with via cost 50, plane via cost 5, start rip-up cost 100, and gives both Sheets an active flag, a preferred direction and along/against costs (F.Cu horizontal 1.0/2.1, B.Cu vertical 1.0/1.9). The block also says (fanout on): both references ignore the fanout flag of a file, so fanoutEnabled stays false. Its router-enable line uses a mis-spelled keyword and is ignored. routerEnabled is false because the case itself passes router: false and the caller always wins over the file.
